name: ret proto-oncogene

function.text: RET encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase that transduces signals from glial-cell-line-derived neurotrophic factor family ligands through coreceptor-dependent signaling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2A (autosomal dominant); multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2B (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Pheochromocytoma; Cutaneous melanoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
